===== FIRESTORE RULES =====


rules_version = '2';

service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {

    // ============================================================
    // Helpers
    // ============================================================

    function signedIn() {
      return request.auth != null;
    }

    function userDoc() {
      return get(
        /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)
      ).data;
    }

    function userRole() {
      return userDoc().role;
    }

    function barberDoc(barberId) {
      return get(
        /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(barberId)
      ).data;
    }

    function ownsShop(shopId) {
      return signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(shopId)
        )
        && get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(shopId)
        ).data.ownerId == request.auth.uid;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // Users
    // ============================================================

    match /users/{userId} {

      // User can read his own document.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && request.auth.uid == userId;

      // Owner can read barber user documents.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && resource.data.role == 'barber';

      // Customer registration/profile creation.
      allow create: if signedIn()
        && request.auth.uid == userId
        && request.resource.data.role == 'customer'
        && request.resource.data.id == userId
        && request.resource.data.barberShopId == null;

      // User cannot change his role or shop assignment himself.
      allow update: if signedIn()
        && request.auth.uid == userId
        && request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role
        && request.resource.data.barberShopId
            == resource.data.barberShopId
        && request.resource.data.id == resource.data.id;

      allow delete: if false;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // Barber Shops
    // ============================================================

    match /barberShops/{shopId} {

      // Customers can browse active shops.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'customer'
        && resource.data.isActive == true;

      // Owner can read his own shop.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && resource.data.ownerId == request.auth.uid;

      // Barbers can browse active shops.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'barber'
        && resource.data.isActive == true;

      // Owner creates his own shop.
      allow create: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && request.resource.data.ownerId == request.auth.uid
        && request.resource.data.name is string
        && request.resource.data.name.size() > 0
        && request.resource.data.timezone is string
        && request.resource.data.timezone.size() > 0
        && request.resource.data.isActive == true
        && request.resource.data.createdAt is timestamp
        && request.resource.data.updatedAt is timestamp;

      // Owner can update his own shop but cannot transfer ownership.
      allow update: if ownsShop(shopId)
        && request.resource.data.ownerId
            == resource.data.ownerId;

      allow delete: if false;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // Barbers
    // ============================================================

    match /barbers/{barberId} {

      // Owner can read barbers belonging to his shop.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && resource.data.barberShopId is string
        && ownsShop(resource.data.barberShopId);

      // Barber can read his own barber profile.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'barber'
        && resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid;

      // Customers can browse active barbers.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'customer'
        && resource.data.isActive == true;

      // Owner creates a barber for a shop he owns.
      allow create: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && request.resource.data.barberShopId is string
        && ownsShop(request.resource.data.barberShopId)
        && request.resource.data.userId is string
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.resource.data.userId)
        )
        && get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.resource.data.userId)
        ).data.role == 'barber'
        && request.resource.data.name is string
        && request.resource.data.name.size() > 0
        && request.resource.data.isActive == true
        && request.resource.data.createdAt is timestamp
        && request.resource.data.updatedAt is timestamp;

      // Owner can update a barber without moving him
      // to another shop or changing the linked user.
      allow update: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && resource.data.barberShopId is string
        && ownsShop(resource.data.barberShopId)
        && request.resource.data.barberShopId
            == resource.data.barberShopId
        && request.resource.data.userId
            == resource.data.userId;

      allow delete: if false;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // Weekly Schedule
    // ============================================================

    match /barbers/{barberId}/weeklySchedule/{dayId} {

      // Customers can read schedules.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'customer';

      // Owner manages schedules of barbers in his shop.
      allow read, create, update: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(barberId)
        )
        && ownsShop(
          barberDoc(barberId).barberShopId
        );

      // Barber manages his own schedule.
      allow read, create, update: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'barber'
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(barberId)
        )
        && barberDoc(barberId).userId == request.auth.uid;

      allow delete: if false;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // Schedule Exceptions
    // ============================================================

    match /barbers/{barberId}/scheduleExceptions/{exceptionId} {

      // Customers can read schedule exceptions.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'customer';

      // Owner manages exceptions for barbers in his shop.
      allow read, create, update, delete: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(barberId)
        )
        && ownsShop(
          barberDoc(barberId).barberShopId
        );

      // Barber manages his own exceptions.
      allow read, create, update, delete: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'barber'
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(barberId)
        )
        && barberDoc(barberId).userId == request.auth.uid;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // Services
    //
    // IMPORTANT:
    // Services exist ONLY under:
    //
    // barberShops/{shopId}/services/{serviceId}
    //
    // There is NO top-level /services/{serviceId} path.
    // ============================================================

    match /barberShops/{shopId}/services/{serviceId} {

      // Customer can read active services.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'customer'
        && resource.data.isActive == true;

      // Owner can read all services of his shop.
      allow read: if ownsShop(shopId);

      // Barber can read active services.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'barber'
        && resource.data.isActive == true;

      // Owner creates services for his own shop.
      allow create: if ownsShop(shopId)
        && request.resource.data.barberShopId == shopId
        && request.resource.data.name is string
        && request.resource.data.name.size() > 0
        && request.resource.data.durationMinutes is int
        && request.resource.data.durationMinutes > 0
        && request.resource.data.durationMinutes % 5 == 0
        && request.resource.data.price is number
        && request.resource.data.price >= 0
        && request.resource.data.isActive == true
        && request.resource.data.createdAt is timestamp
        && request.resource.data.updatedAt is timestamp;

      // Owner updates services without moving them to another shop
      // or changing their original creation timestamp.
      allow update: if ownsShop(shopId)
        && request.resource.data.barberShopId
            == resource.data.barberShopId
        && request.resource.data.barberShopId == shopId
        && request.resource.data.createdAt
            == resource.data.createdAt
        && request.resource.data.name is string
        && request.resource.data.name.size() > 0
        && request.resource.data.durationMinutes is int
        && request.resource.data.durationMinutes > 0
        && request.resource.data.durationMinutes % 5 == 0
        && request.resource.data.price is number
        && request.resource.data.price >= 0
        && request.resource.data.updatedAt is timestamp;

      allow delete: if false;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // Bookings
    // ============================================================

    match /bookings/{bookingId} {

      // Customer can read his own bookings.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'customer'
        && resource.data.customerId == request.auth.uid;

      // Barber can read bookings assigned to him.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'barber'
        && resource.data.barberId is string
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(resource.data.barberId)
        )
        && barberDoc(resource.data.barberId).userId
            == request.auth.uid;

      // Owner can read bookings belonging to his shop.
      allow read: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'owner'
        && resource.data.shopId is string
        && ownsShop(resource.data.shopId);

      // Customer creates a pending booking.
      allow create: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'customer'
        && request.resource.data.customerId
            == request.auth.uid
        && request.resource.data.status == 'pending'
        && request.resource.data.customerId is string
        && request.resource.data.shopId is string
        && request.resource.data.barberId is string
        && request.resource.data.serviceId is string
        && request.resource.data.bookingDate is timestamp
        && request.resource.data.startTime is string
        && request.resource.data.endTime is string
        && request.resource.data.serviceName is string
        && request.resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes is int
        && request.resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes > 0
        && request.resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes % 5 == 0
        && request.resource.data.servicePrice is number
        && request.resource.data.servicePrice >= 0
        && request.resource.data.customerName is string
        && request.resource.data.barberName is string
        && request.resource.data.createdAt is timestamp
        && request.resource.data.updatedAt is timestamp

        // Customer name must match his user document.
        && request.resource.data.customerName
            == userDoc().name

        // Shop must exist and be active.
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(request.resource.data.shopId)
        )
        && get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(request.resource.data.shopId)
        ).data.isActive == true

        // Barber must exist, be active, and belong to the selected shop.
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(request.resource.data.barberId)
        )
        && get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(request.resource.data.barberId)
        ).data.isActive == true
        && get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(request.resource.data.barberId)
        ).data.barberShopId
            == request.resource.data.shopId

        // IMPORTANT:
        // Service is nested under barberShops/{shopId}/services/{serviceId}.
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(request.resource.data.shopId)/services/$(request.resource.data.serviceId)
        )
        && get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(request.resource.data.shopId)/services/$(request.resource.data.serviceId)
        ).data.isActive == true
        && get(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(request.resource.data.shopId)/services/$(request.resource.data.serviceId)
        ).data.barberShopId
            == request.resource.data.shopId

        // Booking snapshot must match the service document.
        && request.resource.data.serviceName
            == get(
              /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(request.resource.data.shopId)/services/$(request.resource.data.serviceId)
            ).data.name
        && request.resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes
            == get(
              /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(request.resource.data.shopId)/services/$(request.resource.data.serviceId)
            ).data.durationMinutes
        && request.resource.data.servicePrice
            == get(
              /databases/$(database)/documents/barberShops/$(request.resource.data.shopId)/services/$(request.resource.data.serviceId)
            ).data.price

        // Booking snapshot must match the barber document.
        && request.resource.data.barberName
            == get(
              /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(request.resource.data.barberId)
            ).data.name;


      // Customer can cancel his own pending booking.
      allow update: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'customer'
        && resource.data.customerId == request.auth.uid
        && resource.data.status == 'pending'
        && request.resource.data.status == 'cancelled'
        && request.resource.data.customerId
            == resource.data.customerId
        && request.resource.data.shopId
            == resource.data.shopId
        && request.resource.data.barberId
            == resource.data.barberId
        && request.resource.data.serviceId
            == resource.data.serviceId
        && request.resource.data.bookingDate
            == resource.data.bookingDate
        && request.resource.data.startTime
            == resource.data.startTime
        && request.resource.data.endTime
            == resource.data.endTime
        && request.resource.data.serviceName
            == resource.data.serviceName
        && request.resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes
            == resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes
        && request.resource.data.servicePrice
            == resource.data.servicePrice
        && request.resource.data.customerName
            == resource.data.customerName
        && request.resource.data.barberName
            == resource.data.barberName
        && request.resource.data.createdAt
            == resource.data.createdAt
        && request.resource.data.updatedAt is timestamp;


      // Barber can update booking status according to the allowed flow.
      allow update: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'barber'
        && resource.data.barberId is string
        && exists(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(resource.data.barberId)
        )
        && barberDoc(resource.data.barberId).userId
            == request.auth.uid
        && request.resource.data.customerId
            == resource.data.customerId
        && request.resource.data.shopId
            == resource.data.shopId
        && request.resource.data.barberId
            == resource.data.barberId
        && request.resource.data.serviceId
            == resource.data.serviceId
        && request.resource.data.bookingDate
            == resource.data.bookingDate
        && request.resource.data.startTime
            == resource.data.startTime
        && request.resource.data.endTime
            == resource.data.endTime
        && request.resource.data.serviceName
            == resource.data.serviceName
        && request.resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes
            == resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes
        && request.resource.data.servicePrice
            == resource.data.servicePrice
        && request.resource.data.customerName
            == resource.data.customerName
        && request.resource.data.barberName
            == resource.data.barberName
        && request.resource.data.createdAt
            == resource.data.createdAt
        && request.resource.data.updatedAt is timestamp
        && (
          (
            resource.data.status == 'pending'
            && (
              request.resource.data.status == 'confirmed'
              || request.resource.data.status == 'cancelled'
            )
          )
          ||
          (
            resource.data.status == 'confirmed'
            && (
              request.resource.data.status == 'completed'
              || request.resource.data.status == 'noShow'
              || request.resource.data.status == 'cancelled'
            )
          )
        );


      // Owner can update booking status for his shop.
      allow update: if ownsShop(resource.data.shopId)
        && request.resource.data.customerId
            == resource.data.customerId
        && request.resource.data.shopId
            == resource.data.shopId
        && request.resource.data.barberId
            == resource.data.barberId
        && request.resource.data.serviceId
            == resource.data.serviceId
        && request.resource.data.bookingDate
            == resource.data.bookingDate
        && request.resource.data.startTime
            == resource.data.startTime
        && request.resource.data.endTime
            == resource.data.endTime
        && request.resource.data.serviceName
            == resource.data.serviceName
        && request.resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes
            == resource.data.serviceDurationMinutes
        && request.resource.data.servicePrice
            == resource.data.servicePrice
        && request.resource.data.customerName
            == resource.data.customerName
        && request.resource.data.barberName
            == resource.data.barberName
        && request.resource.data.createdAt
            == resource.data.createdAt
        && request.resource.data.updatedAt is timestamp
        && (
          (
            resource.data.status == 'pending'
            && (
              request.resource.data.status == 'confirmed'
              || request.resource.data.status == 'cancelled'
            )
          )
          ||
          (
            resource.data.status == 'confirmed'
            && (
              request.resource.data.status == 'completed'
              || request.resource.data.status == 'noShow'
              || request.resource.data.status == 'cancelled'
            )
          )
        );

      allow delete: if false;
    }


    // ============================================================
    // Booking Locks
    // ============================================================

    match /barbers/{barberId}/bookingLocks/{lockId} {

      // Locks are never directly readable.
      allow read: if false;

      // Customer creates a lock as part of the booking transaction.
      allow create: if signedIn()
        && userRole() == 'customer'
        && request.resource.data.bookingId is string
        && request.resource.data.customerId is string
        && request.resource.data.shopId is string
        && request.resource.data.barberId == barberId
        && request.resource.data.date is timestamp
        && request.resource.data.startTime is string
        && request.resource.data.endTime is string
        && request.resource.data.createdAt is timestamp

        // The booking created in the same transaction must belong
        // to the authenticated customer.
        && getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/bookings/$(request.resource.data.bookingId)
        ).customerId == request.auth.uid

        // The lock must belong to the same barber.
        && getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/bookings/$(request.resource.data.bookingId)
        ).barberId == barberId

        // The lock shop must match the booking shop.
        && getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/bookings/$(request.resource.data.bookingId)
        ).shopId == request.resource.data.shopId

        // Booking must still be pending.
        && getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/bookings/$(request.resource.data.bookingId)
        ).status == 'pending';

      allow update: if false;

      // Lock can only be deleted after its booking is cancelled.
      allow delete: if signedIn()
        && resource.data.bookingId is string
        && getAfter(
          /databases/$(database)/documents/bookings/$(resource.data.bookingId)
        ).status == 'cancelled'
        && (
          (
            userRole() == 'customer'
            && getAfter(
              /databases/$(database)/documents/bookings/$(resource.data.bookingId)
            ).customerId == request.auth.uid
          )
          ||
          (
            userRole() == 'barber'
            && exists(
              /databases/$(database)/documents/barbers/$(barberId)
            )
            && barberDoc(barberId).userId == request.auth.uid
            && getAfter(
              /databases/$(database)/documents/bookings/$(resource.data.bookingId)
            ).barberId == barberId
          )
          ||
          (
            userRole() == 'owner'
            && ownsShop(
              getAfter(
                /databases/$(database)/documents/bookings/$(resource.data.bookingId)
              ).shopId
            )
          )
        );
    }


    // ============================================================
    // Default Deny
    // ============================================================

    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }
  }
}
